verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS company-formation and compliance platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only related item is a vague 'Advanced API integrations' line in a bookkeeping plan, which is adjacent at best, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
